instruct: Speak as a natural, friendly American radio DJ. Use clear articulation, an easy conversational pace, a relaxed smile and short natural pauses. Sound warm and present without exaggerated excitement.
humour: a to-do list cancelling its own meeting
an imaginary meeting with no homework
a calendar booking some breathing room
a chair training for a relaxation contest
a clock politely waiting its turn
an agenda going on a short holiday

structureDirections.question: Begin with a real, fresh question about this station mood. Answer it lightly, then hand off naturally to the next title.
structureDirections.observation: Begin with a short declarative observation about the station mood. Use separate sentences for the joke and title handoff. No opening question or command.
structureDirections.invitation: Begin by inviting a small action that suits this station mood. Give the invitation a comic twist, then hand off to the title.
structureDirections.mini-story: Begin an explicitly imaginary tiny scene using a conditional or make-believe cue. Give it a small comic turn, then return to the radio and hand off to the title.
structureDirections.playful reflection: Begin with a playful comparison of the station mood to the supplied comic image. Follow with a warm thought and the title handoff. No opening question or command.
structureDirections.small wish: Begin with a small wish for a mood-aligned pleasure. Add a light joke about the supplied comic image, then hand off to the next title.
